verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a graphics card, and setting up autonomous background automations is a software/agent capability, so the story is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence does not flip this. G-Assist is described only as an assistant that helps tune and control the system, not as a way to schedule or run autonomous automations. Running local AI models and CUDA SDKs are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.
